74.. Remote Public Comment

The Board of Supervisors is debuting a new way to provide public comment during Board meetings. For detailed instructions about using the new system, how to find Board agendas, or more general information, please visit the Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors’ website at www.bos.lacounty.gov.

To address the Board during the live meeting starting at 9:00 a.m. use the information below to connect to the Board meeting:

Registration Instructions

To address the Board, you are encouraged to register by visiting www.publiccomment.lacounty.gov; registration opens at 9:00 a.m. on the day of the meeting:

·	Complete the required fields - be sure to include your phone number if you are participating virtually
·	Choose how you want to provide your comments (In-Person or Virtually)
·	Select the agenda items that you want to comment on and whether you are For, Against, or Neutral on the item
·	Select if you would like to receive text message reminders when your item is up for discussion
·	Click Register
·	Receive Confirmation e-mail

Call-In Instructions

To address the Board virtually during a live meeting, dial the conference line (213) 444-2600 using the telephone number that you provided during registration. Please note that using a different number may delay your access to speak.

·	Press * to access the menu and follow the prompts
o	1 - Listen only
o	3 - Speak on the active item
o	0 - Request to register for multiple items



·	If selected, you will receive a text message reminder when your item is up for discussion on the agenda. 
·	When it is your turn to speak, you will hear a voice announcement and your name

Listen Only

Call (213) 444-2600, press Star (*), after following the prompts, press (1)

Written Testimony

Submit written public comments at: https://publiccomment.bos.lacounty.gov.

76.. Open Session adjourned to Closed Session at 4:24 p.m. following adjournments:

CS-1.
Consider Department Head performance evaluations, pursuant to Government Code Section 54957.

CS-2.
Confer with Labor Negotiators, pursuant to Government Code Section 54957.6:

Agency designated representatives: Fesia Davenport, Chief Executive Officer and designated staff

Employee Organization(s) for represented employees: All individual member unions of the Coalition of County Unions, AFL-CIO; Local 721, SEIU; All affiliated member unions of AFSCME Council 36; Association of Deputy District Attorneys; Los Angeles County Association of Environmental Health Specialists; Los Angeles County Public Defenders; and

Unrepresented employees (all).

Closed Session convened at 4:26 p.m.  Present were Supervisors Hilda L. Solis, Holly J. Mitchell, Lindsey P. Horvath, Kathryn Barger and Janice Hahn, Chair presiding.

Closed Session adjourned at 4:56 p.m.  Present were Supervisors Hilda L. Solis, Holly J. Mitchell, Lindsey P. Horvath, Kathryn Barger and Janice Hahn, Chair presiding.

Open Session reconvened at 4:58 p.m. for the purpose of reporting actions taken in Closed Session.  Present were Supervisors Hilda L. Solis, Holly J. Mitchell, Lindsey P. Horvath, Kathryn Barger and Janice Hahn, Chair presiding.

The Board of Supervisors of the County of Los Angeles, and ex officio the governing body of all other special assessment and taxing districts, agencies and authorities for which said Board so acts, adjourned its meeting at 4:59 p.m.

The Board will hold a Special Meeting on Tuesday, January 17, 2023 at
1:00 p.m.

The next Regular Meeting of the Board will be Tuesday, January 24, 2023 at
9:30 a.m.
